name: screenshot-game-view
description: Captures the Unity Editor Game View. For input mapping, read the result metadata's screenWidth/screenHeight, screenAspectMatchesCapture, and coordinateHint: screenshot pixels map to ui-runtime-click only when aspects match, else the view is letterboxed — target by path/instanceId instead. Also reports pngWidth/pngHeight and gameViewWidth/gameViewHeight.

maxDimension.description: Maximum output width or height. Defaults to 960 to avoid oversized images. Pass the Game View resolution (see gameViewWidth/gameViewHeight in result metadata) for a full-resolution capture.

savePath.description: Optional path to also write the resulting PNG to disk. Accepts an absolute path (e.g. C:/Shots/view.png) or a path relative to the Unity project folder (e.g. ./Temp/view.png). Parent folders are created as needed.
